messages:
maria: Heads-up — cutting the sample-app SDK release but typegen produced a signature reorder that looks like a positional breaking change for TS consumers. Repro: `yarn && yarn typegen && git diff`
ben: Can you paste the diff, please?
maria: Minimal but triggering. Optional query param grouping ended up reordered in the overloads:
```diff
- fetch(items: string[], opts?: {timeout?: number, retry?: boolean})
+ fetch(items: string[], retry?: boolean, opts?: {timeout?: number})
```
cassandra: That surfaces as semver-major for TypeScript if folks used positional args. Our changelog bot only saw a docstring tweak and labeled it as patch — mismatch. :facepalm: 
diego: Did we change the OpenAPI? If not, sounds like a codegen param-flattening heuristic regressed. Which typegen version?
maria: Using `@redwood/typegen` v0.12.3 (published last week). OpenAPI unchanged; typegen produced the new ordering. I think the generator re-groups optional params differently now.
regen-bot: PR #4128 opened by @maria — "typegen: preserve param tuple ordering to avoid positional changes" (CI: pending)
ben: CI smoke tests for sample-app are failing because the packaged SDK has different call signatures. Release blocked until we reconcile semver label vs actual break.
cassandra: Short-term options: patch typegen to emit previous ordering (release 0.12.4), or revert the SDK artifacts and republish with coerced overloads. Also update changelog mapping so signature changes require manual review.
diego: I'll try a low-risk fix to prefer original parameter grouping when optional flags are present. If safe we can push 0.12.4 patch that restores prior TS overloads. If downstream legitimately wanted the new ordering, we'll need a minor bump and clear changelog.
maria: For today's release, I'm going to revert the SDK publish for sample-app and hold the train. Opening a revert PR and flagging changelog entry as "manual review" so the bot doesn't auto-label.
ben: Add a unit test in the codegen pipeline asserting stable overload ordering for optional param groups. We keep hitting nondeterministic reorders in CI.
diego: ACK on the test. Also adding a changelog note to explain the ordering heuristic so future reviewers know why it matters.
maria: Revert PR: https://git.redwood.ai/p/sample-apps/pulls/219 — tagging @cassandra for release decision.
cassandra: I'll hold the release, re-run the checklist once 0.12.4 is published with corrected changelog. Thanks for the fast work.
maria: Followups filed: 1) add deterministic ordering test for typegen in CI, 2) update changelog-bot mapping to flag signature diffs as "semver-impact: review", 3) postmortem if the revert goes through.
ben: If anyone sees regen-diff flakiness, ping me and I'll triage.
diego: Reproducer gist: https://gist.github.com/diego/abcdef — includes the openapi fragment and local `yarn typegen` output.
maria: Closing loop once 0.12.4 patch confirmed and sample-app smoke is green. :thumbsup:
